hook: Grand total ke liye [[calculator]] mat uthao

slides.title: ROLLUP = [[auto total]]
points: Ek extra row, bina extra query ✓
slides.note: Jaise kirane ka bill: items ke neeche **TOTAL** line khud aa jaaye 🧾

slides.title: [[Postgres / SQL Server]]
slides.code:
SELECT dept,
  SUM(salary) AS total
FROM employees
GROUP BY ROLLUP(dept);

slides.title: Result + [[grand total]]
slides.note: Wo **NULL** wali row = grand total. Dept ka naam nahi, sabka jod 🎯

slides.title: [[MySQL]] ka style
slides.code:
SELECT dept,
  SUM(salary) AS total
FROM employees
GROUP BY dept WITH ROLLUP;
slides.note: MySQL = **WITH ROLLUP** end mein. SQL Server dono samajhta hai

slides.title: NULL ko [[naam]] do
points: Par asli NULL dept bhi ho to confusion
slides.note: GROUPING() teeno mein hai (MySQL 8.0+). Report pro lagegi 😎

slides.right:
-- MySQL
GROUP BY dept WITH ROLLUP;
slides.why: MySQL **ROLLUP(dept)** syntax nahi samajhta → error. WITH ROLLUP likho
